label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

country.description: Resolved ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the results were scoped to, upper-case; absent when unscoped

language.description: Result language used, lower-case; absent when Google's default was used

note.description: Present only on a sample response (empty/omitted query): a hint to pass a real query. The paid request ran; no search was made.

results.description: Organic results in ranking order; empty when nothing matched (still HTTP 200)

snippet.description: Result snippet as shown by Google; may be empty

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
